paras_en: On September 10, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Apple (AAPL‑US) launched the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max. The new models focus heavily on on‑device AI processing, featuring the next‑generation A20 Pro chip, increased memory bandwidth, an enhanced thermal system and longer battery life, and a 48MP variable‑aperture main camera. In the U.S., the iPhone 18 Pro starts at $1,199 and the Pro Max at $1,299; pre‑orders open on September 12 and the devices ship on September 18.

The A20 Pro is the core upgrade for this generation of Pro devices. The redesigned chip houses a six‑core CPU delivering up to 20% higher performance than its predecessor, while the GPU moves to a seven‑core design that further boosts graphics and AI‑driven image generation capabilities.

To handle the increased on‑device AI workload, the A20 Pro’s neural engine is upgraded to 32 cores and supports advanced 8‑bit floating‑point operations. Memory bandwidth is also raised by 50%, enabling the iPhone to run larger AI models and high‑load applications more efficiently.

This shift reflects Apple’s AI strategy of moving more compute power directly onto the endpoint. The iPhone 18 Pro can run Apple’s most advanced on‑device AI models, supporting image generation, photo editing, and more complex Siri interactions, as well as natural‑language‑driven automation and cross‑app information retrieval. Related Apple Intelligence features can extend to over 3,000 apps.

With higher chip performance and AI capability, thermal management becomes a key hardware focus. The iPhone 18 Pro adopts a next‑generation vapor‑chamber heat spreader whose surface area is three times that of the system used in the iPhone 17 Pro, and incorporates a new nano‑dual‑copper material to channel heat away from the display area. Apple says the new thermal architecture can improve sustained performance by up to 40% over the previous Pro models.

On the camera side, the iPhone 18 Pro introduces a new 48MP Fusion main sensor with a variable‑aperture design that automatically adjusts light intake based on shooting conditions and also allows manual aperture control for depth‑of‑field effects. Professional shooting features now include manual white‑balance, exposure, histogram and shutter‑speed controls, while video recording gains enhanced Dolby Vision HDR, intelligent tracking focus and improved audio capture.

Battery life is also extended: video playback can last up to 36 hours on the iPhone 18 Pro and 45 hours on the Pro Max, making them the longest‑lasting iPhones to date. Under supported conditions, the iPhone 18 Pro can charge to 50% in roughly 15 minutes.

Pricing is another market focal point. Amid tight global component supply and rising memory costs, Apple raised Mac and iPad prices this summer; now the iPhone 18 Pro’s base price climbs from $1,099 to $1,199, a $100 increase of about 9%, indicating that component cost pressures are beginning to affect flagship phone pricing.

However, the actual price hike remains below earlier, more aggressive market expectations. TrendForce had previously projected a base price of $1,319 for the iPhone 18 Pro and a 10%‑20% increase across the Pro lineup versus the prior generation. The $1,199 starting price shows Apple can upgrade hardware and absorb cost pressures while keeping the premium price rise modest.

From a hardware perspective, this generation’s iPhone Pro upgrades go beyond CPU and camera; they revolve around re‑architecting the chip, memory bandwidth, thermal system and battery for on‑device AI. The 50% boost in memory bandwidth, 32‑core neural engine, and vapor‑chamber area tripled all illustrate how moving AI models to the endpoint forces phone designs to handle higher data transfer, power draw and heat dissipation.

paras: 2026年09月10日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 蘋果Apple(AAPL-US)正在調整沿用多年的iPhone新品發布節奏。今年9月新品發表率先聚焦iPhone 18 Pro與iPhone 18 Pro Max，而非像過去一樣同步推出標準版iPhone；市場並預期首款摺疊iPhone也將成為今年秋季主力產品，標準版iPhone 18與價格較低的iPhone 18e則可能延至2027年春季登場。
這項改變的重點不只是新品延後，而是蘋果可能首次將iPhone產品週期明顯拆成「秋季高階、春季主流」兩個檔期。
過去蘋果通常在每年9月一次推出當年度主要iPhone系列，使新機需求高度集中於美國、歐洲年底購物旺季，也讓公司營收具有明顯季節性。改採分批上市後，高階Pro與摺疊機種可率先承接年底換機需求，標準版與入門機種則於隔年春季接棒，有助將iPhone銷售分散至不同季度。
產品定位也因此更加清楚。2026年秋季新品重心轉向iPhone 18 Pro、iPhone 18 Pro Max及市場關注度較高的摺疊iPhone，蘋果可以把行銷與供應鏈資源集中於高單價產品；2027年春季則預計由標準版iPhone 18、iPhone 18e接棒，iPhone Air 2也可能於相近時間推出。
標準版iPhone 18雖然延後，但市場傳出的硬體升級幅度並不小，包括採用2奈米A20晶片、增加記憶體容量、縮小Dynamic Island，並可能搭載蘋果自行研發的C2數據機晶片。為控制成本，標準版可能採用成本較低的顯示器，並提高與iPhone 18e之間的零組件共用程度。不過，相關規格目前仍屬市場消息，尚未獲蘋果正式確認。
若新產品節奏成形，對供應鏈的影響也值得注意。過去iPhone零組件拉貨與組裝高峰高度集中於下半年，未來若高階機種維持秋季上市、主流與入門機種改至春季推出，部分零組件備貨與組裝需求可能從單一旺季轉向一年兩個較明顯的生產週期。
對蘋果而言，這項策略同時具有產品與財務意義：秋季集中火力銷售高單價Pro及摺疊機種，有利提高高階產品曝光度；春季再以標準版與平價機種創造第二波換機需求，降低iPhone銷售過度集中於年底單一季度的情況。

paras_en: September 10, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Apple (AAPL-US) is adjusting the long‑standing iPhone launch rhythm. This September’s event will focus first on the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, rather than releasing a standard iPhone alongside them as in the past; the market also expects the first foldable iPhone to become the flagship product this fall, while the standard iPhone 18 and the lower‑priced iPhone 18e may be pushed to spring 2027.
The key point of this change is not just a delay of new models, but that Apple may for the first time split the iPhone cycle clearly into an “autumn high‑end” and a “spring mainstream” window.

Historically Apple has launched the main iPhone line once each September, concentrating demand for the new devices around the U.S. and European year‑end shopping season and giving the company’s revenue a pronounced seasonality. By moving to staggered releases, the high‑end Pro and foldable models can capture the year‑end upgrade demand first, while the standard and entry‑level models take over in the following spring, helping spread iPhone sales across different quarters.

Product positioning also becomes clearer. The focus of the 2026 autumn launch shifts to the iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max and the highly anticipated foldable iPhone, allowing Apple to concentrate marketing and supply‑chain resources on high‑price products; the spring 2027 lineup is expected to be led by the standard iPhone 18, iPhone 18e, and possibly an iPhone Air 2 released around the same time.

Although the standard iPhone 18 is delayed, market rumors suggest substantial hardware upgrades, including a 2‑nm A20 chip, increased memory, a smaller Dynamic Island, and possibly Apple’s own C2 modem. To control costs, the standard model may use a cheaper display and share more components with the iPhone 18e. However, these specifications remain unconfirmed rumors and have not been officially validated by Apple.

If the new product cadence takes shape, the impact on the supply chain is noteworthy. In the past, iPhone component orders and assembly peaks were heavily concentrated in the second half of the year. With high‑end models staying on an autumn launch and mainstream and entry‑level models moving to spring, some component stocking and assembly demand could shift from a single peak to two more distinct production cycles per year.

For Apple, this strategy carries both product and financial significance: concentrating the autumn sales push on high‑price Pro and foldable models boosts high‑end product visibility, while a spring wave of standard and budget models creates a second upgrade cycle, reducing the over‑concentration of iPhone sales in the year‑end quarter.

items.title: 伊朗南部連環爆炸 胡塞武裝逼近曼德海峽 布蘭特原油升破101美元
items.title_en: Southern Iran Chain Explosions, Houthi Forces Near Strait of Hormuz, Brent Crude Breaks $101
paras: 中東兩條重要航運水道周邊局勢同步升溫。伊朗南部沿海地區週四 (10 日) 凌晨接連傳出爆炸，葉門獲伊朗支持的胡塞武裝則沿紅海海岸推進，逐步逼近可俯瞰曼德海峽的戰略要地，為區域衝突開闢新戰線的風險升高。
《安納杜魯新聞社》引述伊朗媒體報導，伊朗官方通訊社《IRNA》表示，錫里克 (Sirik) 數個地區遭「敵對投射物」擊中，但未進一步說明攻擊來源及損害情況。
伊朗《法斯通訊社》則引述地方官員表示，除錫里克外，米納卜 (Minab) 及格什姆島 (Qeshm Island) 也傳出爆炸，聲響來自海上方向。
格什姆島是波斯灣最大的島嶼，因扼守全球能源咽喉「荷姆茲海峽」而具有極其關鍵的軍事與地理戰略地位
就在前一天，《法斯通訊社》曾報導，伊朗南部城市賈斯克 (Jask) 也傳出由海上方向傳來的爆炸聲。
這波事件發生之際，美國與伊朗正因荷姆茲海峽局勢關係緊張。雙方儘管已於6月簽署備忘錄，規劃以重新開放這條戰略水道作為達成更廣泛和平協議的前奏，緊張情勢仍未平息。
與此同時，葉門戰事也出現向紅海航道擴大的風險。
《半島電視台》報導，獲伊朗支持的胡塞武裝正沿紅海海岸及塔伊茲省 (Taiz) 山區推進，逐步接近可俯瞰曼德海峽的戰略地帶。(曼德海峽是全球最重要的海上交通要道之一。)
葉門政府認為，胡塞武裝這波攻勢可能造成全球性後果。
葉門駐卡達大使、前政府發言人巴迪 (Rajeh Badi) 週三接受《半島電視台》訪問時表示，葉門政府及其武裝部隊自2021年以來從未違反任何停火協議。
隨著伊朗南部沿岸與葉門紅海戰線同時升溫，市場擔憂中東能源供應進一步中斷，國際油價延續漲勢。布蘭特原油期貨上漲 3.36%，收每桶 101.21 美元；西德州原油期貨上漲 3.25%，收每桶 96.05 美元，兩者均創 5 月以來最高收盤價。
paras_en: The situation around two key Middle‑East shipping lanes is heating up simultaneously. In the early hours of Thursday (the 10th), a series of explosions were reported along Iran’s southern coast, and Yemen’s Iran‑backed Houthi forces are advancing along the Red Sea coast, gradually approaching a strategic point that overlooks the Strait of Hormuz, raising the risk of a new front in the regional conflict.

The Anadolu News Agency cited Iranian media reports that the official Iranian news agency IRNA said several areas in Sirik were hit by “hostile projectiles,” but gave no further details on the source of the attacks or the damage.
Iran’s Fars News Agency quoted local officials as saying that, in addition to Sirik, explosions were also reported in Minab and on Qeshm Island, with the sounds coming from the sea direction.
Qeshm Island, the largest island in the Persian Gulf, holds an extremely critical military and geographic strategic position because it guards the world‑energy chokepoint of the Strait of Hormuz.
Just a day earlier, Fars News Agency had reported that the southern Iranian city of Jask also heard explosion sounds coming from the sea direction.

These incidents occur as the United States and Iran remain tense over the Hormuz Strait situation. Although the two sides signed a memorandum in June outlining plans to reopen the strategic waterway as a prelude to a broader peace agreement, the tension has not eased.
At the same time, the war in Yemen also shows a risk of expanding toward the Red Sea shipping route.

Al‑Jazeera reported that Iran‑backed Houthi forces are advancing along the Red Sea coast and the mountainous Taiz province, gradually drawing closer to a strategic area that overlooks the Strait of Hormuz, which is one of the world’s most important maritime traffic routes.
The Yemeni government believes this Houthi offensive could have global repercussions.

Yemen’s ambassador to Qatar and former government spokesman Rajeh Badi told Al‑Jazeera on Wednesday that Yemen’s government and its armed forces have not violated any cease‑fire agreements since 2021.

As the southern Iranian coast and the Yemeni Red Sea front both heat up, markets worry about further disruptions to Middle‑East energy supplies, pushing international oil prices higher. Brent crude futures rose 3.36% to $101.21 a barrel, while West Texas Intermediate gained 3.25% to $96.05 a barrel, both hitting their highest close since May.

items.title: iPhone Duo正式亮相 蘋果發表會六大重點快速看懂

paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) 周三(9日)推出公司首款摺疊智慧手機，希望藉由切入全新品類，為旗下最暢銷的 iPhone 產品線注入成長動能。
這款新機命名為 iPhone Duo。新任執行長特努斯表示，iPhone Duo 將優於競爭對手的摺疊機型，並嘲諷其他品牌的產品就像是「兩支手機笨拙地黏在一起」。
iPhone Duo 展開後配備 7.6 吋（19.3 公分）螢幕，是歷來螢幕尺寸最大的 iPhone。手機摺疊時，外側另有一塊 5.4 吋螢幕可供使用。今年稍晚起，iPhone Duo 也將支援 iPad 的 Apple Pencil 觸控筆。
透過這次產品線擴張，蘋果希望證明，公司有能力進一步改良由三星電子（Samsung Electronics）等智慧手機業者率先開拓的摺疊機市場。
iPhone Duo 強調更堅固的機身質感，展開後螢幕中央的摺痕也較不明顯。軟體介面則針對新硬體重新設計，讓使用者操作時能更充分整合內外兩塊螢幕。
iPhone Duo 將定位於蘋果 iPhone 產品線最高階，256GB 儲存容量版本起售價為 1,999 美元。蘋果將於 10 月 16 日在超過 70 個國家和地區開放預購，10 月 23 日正式上市；最高階 2TB 儲存容量版本售價則達 3,199 美元。
這款摺疊手機是 iPhone 問世近 20 年來最大幅度的設計變革。不過，由於新品發表早已受到市場廣泛預期，投資人反應相對平淡。蘋果股價周三在紐約交易時段變動不大，終場收在 315.34 美元。
以下是蘋果年度 9 月硬體發表會的六大重點。蘋果在會中發表首款摺疊手機 iPhone Duo，以及多款新品：
1.蘋果正將 iPhone 定位為人工智慧（AI）時代的核心裝置，同時持續開發面向未來的新型態產品。
2.iPhone Duo 起售價為 1,999 美元，主打獨特的使用者介面，並搭載具競爭力的相機功能。
3.iPhone 18 Pro 的升級重點集中在相機，同時新增黑色、勃根地紅等配色，有望讓新機與去年機型形成更明顯區隔。一般而言，採用新設計的第二代 iPhone，銷量通常優於第一代。
4.iPhone 18 Pro 宣稱電池續航力將迎來「大幅躍進」，其中 iPhone 18 Pro 續航時間可達 36 小時，iPhone 18 Pro Max 則達 45 小時。
5.新款 AirPods 5 升級幅度不算大，但 129 美元與 149 美元的售價仍可能吸引消費者，尤其較高階版本具備更長電池續航力與無線充電功能。
6.蘋果也重新定位 Apple Watch，將其打造為旗下 AI 穿戴裝置，並加入全新的 Siri Recaps 功能。這項功能與 Amazon Bee 及近期多款新型穿戴裝置相似，可聆聽並記錄使用者一天的活動內容，再提供摘要整理。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) on Wednesday (the 9th) launched its first foldable smartphone, aiming to inject growth momentum into its best‑selling iPhone product line by entering an entirely new category.
The new device is called the iPhone Duo. New CEO Tim Cook said the iPhone Duo will outperform rival foldable models and mocked competitors’ products as “two phones clumsily stuck together.”

When unfolded, the iPhone Duo sports a 7.6‑inch (19.3‑cm) display, the largest screen ever on an iPhone. When folded, a secondary 5.4‑inch screen on the outside remains usable. Later this year the iPhone Duo will also support the Apple Pencil used with iPads.
Through this product‑line expansion, Apple wants to prove it can further improve the foldable‑phone market that Samsung Electronics and other smartphone makers pioneered.

The iPhone Duo emphasizes a more robust build quality, with a less noticeable crease in the center of the unfolded screen. The software interface has been redesigned for the new hardware, allowing users to seamlessly integrate the inner and outer displays during operation.

The iPhone Duo will sit at the top of Apple’s iPhone lineup, with the 256 GB version priced at $1,999. Apple will open pre‑orders on October 16 in more than 70 countries and regions, with official sales beginning on October 23; the top‑end 2 TB model will cost $3,199.

This foldable phone represents the most significant design change for the iPhone in nearly 20 years. However, because the launch was widely anticipated, investor reaction was muted. Apple’s share price barely moved during New York trading on Wednesday, closing at $315.34.
Below are the six main highlights from Apple’s September hardware event. Apple unveiled its first foldable phone, the iPhone Duo, along with several other new products:
1. Apple is positioning the iPhone as the core device for the artificial‑intelligence (AI) era while continuing to develop next‑generation product formats for the future.
2. The iPhone Duo starts at $1,999, featuring a unique user interface and competitive camera capabilities.

3. The iPhone 18 Pro’s upgrades focus on the camera and add new colors such as black and burgundy, expected to create a clearer distinction from last year’s model. Historically, second‑generation iPhones with new designs sell better than the first generation.
4. The iPhone 18 Pro claims a “significant leap” in battery life, with the iPhone 18 Pro reaching up to 36 hours and the iPhone 18 Pro Max up to 45 hours of usage.
5. The new AirPods 5 see modest upgrades, but their $129 and $149 price points may still attract buyers, especially since the higher‑end version offers longer battery life and wireless charging.

6. Apple is also re‑positioning the Apple Watch as its AI wear‑able, adding a brand‑new Siri Recaps feature. This function, similar to Amazon’s Bee and several recent wearables, listens to and records a user’s daily activities and then provides a summarized recap.

items.title: 為何高通AI晶片交易 反而證明輝達仍是市場霸主？
items.title_en: Why Qualcomm's AI Chip Deal Actually Proves Nvidia Still Dominates the Market
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，又一筆看似無止境的人工智慧(AI)晶片交易達成。高通(Qualcomm)(QCOM-US)已與亞馬遜(AMZN-US)簽約，成為其處理器客戶，但從這筆交易的規模與架構來看，高通距離成為輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA-US)的重大威脅仍相當遙遠。
輝達股價周三收盤下跌0.9%，報223.67美元，前一日已下跌2%。高通股價則上漲1.3%，報176.40美元，周二已大漲3.2%。
部分股東可能擔心，高通周二宣布將與亞馬遜合作開發客製化晶片，會侵蝕輝達與這家電商巨頭的業務。不過，仔細看看這筆交易的內容，就能發現情況並非如此。
首先是交易規模。高通與亞馬遜交易的整體金額最高達600億美元，但這筆金額是分散在未來10年內。高通仍維持其2029會計年度資料中心營收達150億美元的預測，相比之下，輝達最新一季單季資料中心營收就達890億美元。
其次看交易條款。高通已向亞馬遜發行認股權證，允許亞馬遜最多取得2,500萬股高通股票，條件與亞馬遜購買高通產品及服務掛鉤。
這種認股權證並非前所未見。AMD(AMD-US)與其晶片客戶Meta Platforms(META-US)及OpenAI也有類似的股票認股權證安排。但這也凸顯雙方議價能力的不對等——輝達並未以讓出股權作為交換，就取得亞馬遜近期承諾在未來兩年額外購買200萬顆輝達晶片的訂單。
此外，高通與亞馬遜表示，雙方合作將聚焦於AI推理，也就是根據AI模型產生輸出，而非輝達最核心的AI訓練領域。
科技研究公司Futurum Group執行長Daniel Newman表示，「推理更重視能源效率，而不是峰值效能。這正是高通的主場。這是在侵蝕輝達的利潤空間，而不是正面挑戰AI訓練市場。」
未來仍會有更多競爭者向輝達的AI晶片市場發起挑戰，但這並不代表輝達短期內就會拱手讓出市場霸主地位。
paras_en: Baron Weekly reported that another seemingly endless AI chip deal has been struck. Qualcomm (QCOM-US) has signed a contract with Amazon (AMZN-US) to become its processor customer, but based on the size and structure of this deal, Qualcomm is still far from being a major threat to Nvidia (NVDA-US).
Nvidia's stock closed down 0.9% on Wednesday at $223.67, after falling 2% the previous day. Qualcomm's stock rose 1.3% to $176.40, after jumping 3.2% on Tuesday.

Some shareholders may worry that Qualcomm's Tuesday announcement of a custom chip partnership with Amazon could erode Nvidia's business with the e‑commerce giant. However, a closer look at the deal shows that this is not the case.

First, the deal size. The total value of Qualcomm's transaction with Amazon can reach up to $60 billion, but that amount is spread over the next ten years. Qualcomm still projects data‑center revenue of $15 billion for its fiscal year 2029, whereas Nvidia's latest quarterly data‑center revenue was $89 billion.
Second, the deal terms. Qualcomm has issued warrants to Amazon, allowing it to acquire up to 25 million Qualcomm shares, with conditions tied to Amazon's purchases of Qualcomm products and services.

Such warrants are not unprecedented. AMD (AMD-US) has similar stock‑warrant arrangements with its chip customers Meta Platforms (META-US) and OpenAI. However, this also highlights an imbalance in bargaining power—Nvidia secured a commitment from Amazon for an additional order of 2 million Nvidia chips over the next two years without giving up any equity.
Moreover, Qualcomm and Amazon said the collaboration will focus on AI inference—generating outputs from AI models—rather than Nvidia's core AI training segment.

Futurum Group CEO Daniel Newman said, "Inference places more emphasis on energy efficiency rather than peak performance. That's Qualcomm's sweet spot. This chips away at Nvidia's profit margin rather than directly challenging the AI training market."
More competitors will continue to challenge Nvidia's AI chip market, but that does not mean Nvidia will relinquish its dominant position in the short term.

items.title: 油價衝破100美元 歐元區通膨升至3.3% ECB周四再升息幾成定局
items.title_en: Oil Prices Break $100, Euro‑Area Inflation Rises to 3.3% – ECB’s Thursday Rate Hike Almost Certain
paras: 歐洲中央銀行(ECB)周四(10日)可望今年第二度升息, 將存款利率由2.25%上調25個基點至2.50%, 以因應伊朗戰爭導致能源價格飆升、通膨重新升溫的風險。市場幾乎已完全消化這項升息預期, 目前真正受到關注的是總裁拉加德(Christine Lagarde)將如何描述後續政策路徑, 以及最新經濟預測是否會為進一步緊縮留下空間。
自8月底以來, 美國與伊朗之間的戰事再度升溫, 雙方攻擊軍事、航運及能源相關目標, 導致石油與天然氣價格重新大幅上揚。布蘭特原油周三一度突破每桶100美元, 最終收在101.21美元, 單日上漲3.4%, 創5月22日以來最高收盤價。能源價格急升使原本已逐步降溫的歐元區通膨面臨再次上行的壓力。
歐元區8月通膨率已由7月的2.9%升至3.3%, 明顯高於ECB 2%的中期目標。Eurostat初步數據顯示, 能源是推升物價的最大因素, 8月能源價格年增率達14.3%, 高於7月的10.3%; 服務價格年增率則由3.3%降至3.0%, 非能源工業商品價格由0.9%升至1.2%, 食品、酒類及菸草價格年增率維持1.2%。
相較整體通膨, 核心通膨仍提供ECB一些政策空間。剔除能源及食品後的核心通膨率8月降至2.4%, 顯示目前物價壓力主要集中於能源, 尚未全面擴散至更廣泛的商品及服務。市場因此認為, ECB此次升息更接近「保險式」升息, 主要目的是防止能源價格衝擊演變成更持久的通膨問題。
ECB此前已在6月升息25個基點, 這是近3年來首次升息。7月會議則暫停調整利率, 但會議紀要顯示, 決策官員當時已認為若通膨前景未明顯改善, 後續仍可能需要再次升息。ECB並強調, 7月的按兵不動只是一次「暫停」, 並不代表緊縮週期已經結束。
當時ECB也警告, 能源價格衝擊的完整影響尚未完全反映在通膨數據中。若能源價格維持高檔時間延長, 可能透過食品、商品及服務價格, 以及工資與通膨預期等第二輪效應, 使通膨長時間高於2%目標。ECB 7月聲明指出, 能源價格在中東衝突後已明顯高於衝突前水準, 相關衝擊仍是經濟前景的重要不確定因素。
經濟表現相對具韌性, 則是支持ECB進一步升息的重要因素。21國組成的歐元區經濟在能源成本上升、中國競爭加劇及乾旱衝擊下, 表現仍優於先前預期。7月企業貸款也加速成長, 企業貸款增幅達4.4%, 創3年多來最快速度, 顯示ECB先前的升息尚未對企業活動造成明顯打擊, 也讓決策官員在必要時仍有進一步收緊政策的空間。
不過, 金融環境其實已經明顯收緊。歐元區長期公債殖利率升至全球金融危機前以來罕見的高位, 背後除了通膨疑慮, 也包括各國政府債務快速增加及大型科技企業為AI投資積極發債等因素。德國政治不確定性則進一步增加市場對歐洲財政及債券供給的擔憂。
能源價格的最新變化也使ECB面臨更複雜的政策取捨。ECB預計在周四同步公布新的經濟預測, 市場普遍預期央行可能上修今年經濟成長預測, 甚至調高2027年預測, 反映歐元區經濟展現韌性。然而, 通膨回到2%目標的時間可能被往後推遲。
ECB 6月公布的預測原本估計, 受能源價格衝擊影響, 2026年通膨率平均將達3.0%, 2027年降至2.3%, 2028年回到2.0%。央行當時預期能源價格下滑及其他價格漲幅放緩, 將協助通膨在2027年下半年回到目標。
然而, 最新油價走勢可能讓這項預測面臨重新調整的壓力。若荷姆茲海峽航運持續受到干擾, 或美伊戰事進一步擴大, 原油及天然氣價格可能維持高檔更長時間, 將提高歐元區進口能源成本, 並使通膨降溫速度慢於ECB原先預期。
部分市場人士因此開始預期ECB可能在9月升息後, 仍保留進一步收緊政策的選項。德意志銀行(Deutsche Bank)本周已將ECB今年12月再升息25個基點的預期納入基本情境, 預估終點利率可能達2.75%; 不過該行也認為, 如果地緣政治緊張局勢緩解、能源價格下降且經濟成長放緩, ECB仍可能將利率維持在2.50%。
路透先前對65名經濟學家的調查則顯示, 多數受訪者預期ECB 9月升息後將暫停, 存款利率可能維持2.50%至2027年中。當時經濟學家預估, 歐元區2026年經濟成長率為0.8%, 2027年為1.2%, 而通膨率則可能要到2027年底才完全回到2%目標附近。
金融市場目前的定價則更加鷹派。市場除了幾乎完全消化9月升息25個基點外, 也押注ECB到2026年底仍可能再升息1至2次。歐洲股市周三已受到油價及利率升高衝擊, 泛歐STOXX 600指數下跌1.4%, 跌至逾1個月低點; 歐元區政府債殖利率也升至多年高位。
ECB面臨的核心問題在於, 當前通膨主要由能源供應衝擊推動, 升息並不能直接降低原油或天然氣價格。若過度緊縮, 反而可能進一步壓抑消費、投資及經濟成長。因此, ECB勢必需要觀察能源價格是否進一步傳導至核心商品、服務及薪資, 再決定是否有必要在9月之後繼續升息。
目前核心通膨降至2.4%, 消費者對未來物價漲幅的預期也有所下降, 薪資增幅則逐步放緩, 這些因素都支持ECB在9月升息後暫停行動。然而, 巴克萊(Barclays)分析師警告, 通膨壓力可能正在表面下方累積, 核心商品價格漲勢重新加快, 生產者價格的增速也明顯高於消費者價格, 可能為未來幾季中東衝突造成的通膨效應提供更高的傳導基礎。
ING全球宏觀主管Carsten Brzeski則指出, 至少目前德國企業仍在吸收較高成本, 尚未如2022年俄羅斯入侵烏克蘭後的能源危機那般, 將成本大幅轉嫁給消費者。若企業未來開始將能源、運輸及供應鏈成本全面反映至售價, ECB將面臨更大的升息壓力。
除了利率決策之外, ECB總裁拉加德的未來任期也可能成為記者會焦點。拉加德任期原定至2027年10月31日, 近期外界曾多次將她與世界經濟論壇領導職位連結。她7月曾表示, 希望未來以某種形式推動歐洲價值, 並參與明年的法國總統大選相關活動。當時面對是否提前離任的詢問, 她明確表示「你們不會在2027年前看到我的背影」。
此外, 近期有報導稱ECB執委Isabel Schnabel可能與國際貨幣基金(IMF)洽談職務, 若最終成真, 可能引發歐元區央行高層人事調整。
因此, 周四的ECB會議不僅是一次例行升息決策, 更可能成為判斷歐洲貨幣政策是否正式進入新一輪緊縮階段的重要轉折點。市場已基本確定9月升息, 後續真正關鍵將是拉加德如何評估油價衝擊、核心通膨、薪資及經濟成長, 以及ECB是否認為需要在年底前再次升息。若中東戰事持續推升能源價格, 歐洲可能面臨「高通膨與低成長」風險重新升高的局面。
paras_en: The European Central Bank (ECB) is expected on Thursday (the 10th) to raise rates for the second time this year, lifting the deposit rate by 25 basis points from 2.25% to 2.50% to counter the risk of soaring energy prices and a resurgence of inflation caused by the Iran war. The market has almost fully priced in this hike; the focus now is on how President Christine Lagarde will describe the policy path ahead and whether the latest economic forecasts will leave room for further tightening.

Since the end of August, fighting between the United States and Iran has intensified, with attacks on military, shipping and energy targets that have sent oil and natural‑gas prices sharply higher again. Brent crude briefly broke $100 a barrel on Wednesday, closing at $101.21, up 3.4% on the day and posting its highest close since May 22. The surge in energy prices is putting fresh upward pressure on euro‑area inflation, which had been cooling.

Euro‑area inflation for August rose from 2.9% in July to 3.3%, clearly above the ECB’s medium‑term target of 2%. Preliminary Eurostat data show energy as the main driver, with energy prices up 14.3% year‑on‑year in August, versus 10.3% in July; services inflation fell to 3.0% from 3.3%; non‑energy industrial goods rose to 1.2% from 0.9%; and food, alcohol and tobacco remained at a 1.2% annual increase.

Core inflation, which excludes energy and food, still gives the ECB some policy space. Core inflation fell to 2.4% in August, indicating that price pressure is currently concentrated in energy and has not yet spread broadly across goods and services. Markets therefore see this rate hike as more of an “insurance” move, aimed at preventing an energy‑price shock from turning into a more persistent inflation problem.

The ECB previously raised rates by 25 basis points in June – the first hike in three years. The July meeting left rates unchanged, but the minutes showed policymakers already believed that if inflation did not improve markedly, another hike could be needed later. The ECB stressed that July’s pause was only a “temporary halt,” not the end of the tightening cycle.

At that time the ECB warned that the full impact of the energy‑price shock had not yet been reflected in inflation data. If high energy prices persist, second‑round effects – through food, commodities, services, wages and inflation expectations – could keep inflation above the 2% target for an extended period. The July statement noted that energy prices after the Middle‑East conflict were already clearly above pre‑conflict levels, remaining a major source of uncertainty for the economic outlook.

Relatively resilient economic performance is a key factor supporting further rate hikes. The euro‑area economy, comprising 21 countries, has performed better than expected despite higher energy costs, tougher competition from China and drought impacts. Corporate loan growth accelerated in July, rising 4.4% – the fastest pace in more than three years – suggesting that the June hike has not yet hit corporate activity hard and leaving policymakers room to tighten further if needed.

Nevertheless, the financial environment has already tightened noticeably. Long‑term euro‑area sovereign yields have climbed to levels rarely seen since before the global financial crisis, driven not only by inflation worries but also by rapidly rising sovereign debt and large tech firms issuing debt aggressively for AI investments. Political uncertainty in Germany adds further concern about European fiscal and bond‑supply conditions.

The latest energy‑price developments also make the ECB’s policy trade‑offs more complex. The ECB is expected to release new economic forecasts on Thursday, and markets broadly anticipate that the bank may revise up its growth projection for this year and possibly its 2027 outlook, reflecting the euro‑area’s resilience. However, the timing for inflation to return to the 2% target may be pushed further out.

The ECB’s June forecast had projected that, after the energy‑price shock, average inflation would be 3.0% in 2026, falling to 2.3% in 2027 and reaching 2.0% in 2028. The bank then expected that falling energy prices and slower price growth elsewhere would help bring inflation back to target in the second half of 2027.

But the recent oil‑price trajectory could force a reassessment of those projections. If disruptions in the Hormuz Strait persist or the US‑Iran conflict widens, oil and gas prices could stay elevated longer, raising the euro‑area’s imported energy costs and slowing the disinflation pace beyond the ECB’s original expectations.

Some market participants now expect that even after a September hike, the ECB will keep the option to tighten further. Deutsche Bank this week incorporated a scenario of a further 25‑basis‑point hike in December, projecting a terminal rate of about 2.75%. The bank added that if geopolitical tensions ease, energy prices fall and growth slows, the ECB could leave rates at 2.50%.

A Reuters poll of 65 economists showed most respondents expected the ECB to pause after a September hike, with the deposit rate staying at 2.50% until mid‑2027. Those economists projected euro‑area growth of 0.8% in 2026 and 1.2% in 2027, with inflation not returning fully to the 2% target until the end of 2027.

Financial markets are now pricing in a more hawkish stance. In addition to having almost fully priced in a 25‑basis‑point hike in September, markets are betting that the ECB could raise rates one or two more times by the end of 2026. European equities fell on Wednesday under the weight of higher oil and rate expectations, with the pan‑European STOXX 600 down 1.4% to a more‑than‑one‑month low, while euro‑area sovereign yields rose to multi‑year highs.

The core issue for the ECB is that current inflation is driven mainly by an energy‑supply shock, and raising rates does not directly lower oil or gas prices. Over‑tightening could instead suppress consumption, investment and growth. Therefore, the ECB will need to watch whether energy prices feed further into core goods, services and wages before deciding if additional hikes after September are warranted.

Core inflation has now fallen to 2.4%, consumer inflation expectations have eased and wage growth is moderating – factors that support a pause after a September hike. Yet Barclays analysts warn that inflation pressure may be building beneath the surface, with core commodity prices picking up again and producer‑price inflation running noticeably faster than consumer‑price inflation, potentially providing a stronger transmission channel for any future Middle‑East‑driven inflation.

ING global macro head Carsten Brzeski noted that German firms are still absorbing higher costs and have not yet passed them on to consumers to the extent seen after Russia’s 2022 invasion of Ukraine. If firms eventually start reflecting higher energy, transport and supply‑chain costs in their prices, the ECB could face stronger pressure to raise rates further.

Beyond the rate decision, President Lagarde’s remaining term may become a focal point of the press conference. Lagarde’s mandate runs until 31 October 2027, and recent speculation has linked her to a possible leadership role at the World Economic Forum. In July she said she hopes to promote European values in some form and to take part in activities related to next year’s French presidential election. When asked whether she might leave early, she replied unequivocally, “You will not see me out of office before 2027.”

There are also reports that ECB Executive Board member Isabel Schnabel is in talks with the International Monetary Fund about a possible position, which, if confirmed, could trigger a reshuffle at the top of the euro‑area central bank.

Thus Thursday’s ECB meeting is more than a routine rate hike; it could be a decisive turning point for judging whether European monetary policy is entering a new tightening phase. The market has essentially locked in a September hike, and the real question now is how Lagarde will assess the oil‑price shock, core inflation, wages and growth, and whether the ECB deems another hike necessary before year‑end. If the Middle‑East conflict continues to push energy prices higher, Europe could face a renewed “high‑inflation, low‑growth” risk scenario.

items.title: 蘋果定價策略迎終極考驗 Pro漲100美元低預期 華爾街緊盯毛利率
items.title_en: Apple's Pricing Strategy Faces Ultimate Test as Pro Rises $100 Below Expectations, Wall Street Watches Margins
paras: 蘋果全面調高iPhone售價後，華爾街將焦點轉向這項定價策略能否兼顧需求與毛利率。分析師認為，新款Pro系列漲幅低於部分市場預期，意味蘋果可能自行吸收部分成本；另一方面，產品陣容全面偏向高階機型，也提高了消費者是否願意升級的不確定性。
蘋果在秋季發表會推出iPhone 18 Pro與iPhone 18 Pro Max，美國起售價分別為1,199美元及1,299美元，均較上一代調漲100美元。
摩根大通 (JPMorgan) 分析師指出，這項定價略低於華爾街原先預期，漲價至少部分反映記憶體價格攀升。
發表會前，華爾街普遍認為iPhone漲價已難以避免，分歧主要集中於調漲幅度。
摩根士丹利分析師Erik Woodring預估，全系列價格可能上調最多200美元；傑富瑞 (Jefferies) 分析師Edison Lee預測，漲幅可能達百分之十幾；摩根大通分析師Samik Chatterjee提出的基本情境則是調漲100美元。
最終，Pro與Pro Max售價均上調100美元，符合摩根大通的基本預測，但低於部分分析師原先估計。
TrendForce 報告顯示，蘋果採購iPhone 18 Pro記憶體的成本較過往高出400%。該機構預料，蘋果可能自行吸收部分漲價壓力，避免將成本增幅完全轉嫁給消費者。這項做法有助控制售價，卻也可能使蘋果毛利率承受壓力。
Vital Knowledge同樣注意到，Pro與Pro Max僅漲價100美元，落在市場原先預估100至200美元區間的低端，因此可能引發外界對毛利率的疑慮。
不過，該機構認為，蘋果似乎正試圖推動整體產品組合轉向高階機型，藉由提高高價產品銷售占比抵銷部分成本壓力。
蘋果此次如預期未發表標準版iPhone 18，使秋季新品陣容集中於高階產品。
摩根大通的Chatterjee指出，分階段發布策略顯示蘋果重新強化高階市場布局，透過凸顯高階機型的規格與功能，引導消費者選購價格更高的產品。
不過，僅由高階機型支撐的秋季產品陣容，也可能為未來幾季的iPhone銷售增添不確定性。
Chatterjee表示，蘋果截至2026年12月止一季的業績，將比過去更依賴高階產品。這項策略雖可能推升裝置平均售價，成敗仍取決於消費者是否願意立即升級，而非等待明年推出價格較低的標準版。
針對蘋果整體定價策略，傑富瑞維持「跑輸大市」評等及263.66美元目標價。
該機構以iPhone 17及Air系列售價未調整為前提，認為此舉雖有助支撐需求，但在記憶體及先進製程晶圓成本攀升的環境下，可能使蘋果承受更大的毛利率壓力。
蘋果 (AAPL-US) 週三終場小幅下跌 0.28%，收在 315.34 美元，盤中最高曾觸及 319.15 美元。
paras_en: After Apple raised iPhone prices across the board, Wall Street shifted its focus to whether the pricing strategy can balance demand and gross margins. Analysts say the modest price hike for the new Pro line falls short of some market expectations, suggesting Apple may absorb part of the cost itself; at the same time, the entire product lineup leans toward premium models, raising uncertainty about whether consumers will be willing to upgrade.
Apple unveiled the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max at its autumn event, with U.S. starting prices of $1,199 and $1,299 respectively, each $100 higher than the previous generation.
JPMorgan analysts noted that this pricing is slightly below Wall Street’s original expectations, and the increase at least partially reflects rising memory costs.
Before the event, Wall Street generally believed a price hike for the iPhone was inevitable, with disagreements mainly about the magnitude of the increase.

Morgan Stanley analyst Erik Woodring estimated that the entire lineup could see price hikes of up to $200; Jefferies analyst Edison Lee forecast a double‑digit percent increase; JPMorgan analyst Samik Chatterjee’s baseline scenario was a $100 increase.
In the end, both the Pro and Pro Max prices rose $100, matching JPMorgan’s baseline forecast but falling short of some analysts’ earlier estimates.

A TrendForce report shows Apple’s cost for memory in the iPhone 18 Pro is about 400% higher than in the past. The firm expects Apple may absorb part of the price pressure to avoid passing the full cost increase onto consumers. This helps keep the sticker price down but could pressure Apple’s gross margin.
Vital Knowledge also noted that the $100 hike for the Pro and Pro Max sits at the low end of the market’s original $100‑$200 range, potentially sparking concerns about margins.
However, the firm believes Apple appears to be shifting the overall product mix toward premium models, using a higher share of high‑price sales to offset some cost pressure.
As expected, Apple did not launch a standard iPhone 18, concentrating the autumn lineup on premium products.

JPMorgan’s Chatterjee said the staged‑release strategy shows Apple reinforcing its high‑end market positioning, highlighting premium specs and features to steer consumers toward higher‑priced devices.
Nevertheless, an autumn lineup supported only by premium models could add uncertainty to iPhone sales in the coming quarters.

Chatterjee noted that Apple’s Q1 results ending December 2026 will rely more on premium products than before. While the strategy could lift the average selling price, its success hinges on whether consumers choose to upgrade now rather than wait for a lower‑priced standard model next year.
Regarding Apple’s overall pricing strategy, Jefferies maintains an “underperform” rating with a target price of $263.66.

The firm assumes iPhone 17 and Air series prices remain unchanged, believing this helps support demand but, amid rising memory and advanced‑process wafer costs, could increase pressure on Apple’s gross margins.
Apple (AAPL-US) closed Wednesday slightly down 0.28% at $315.34, after reaching an intraday high of $319.15.

items.title: 貝森特自稱莊家 對日元與美股意味著什麼？
items.title_en: Biden Claims to Be the House: What It Means for the Yen and US Stocks
paras: 美國財長貝森特向來直言不諱，但他周二晚間在南方衛理公會大學商學院發表的談話，可能是其從政以來態度最強硬的一次。
貝森特談到的，不只是美國財政部近期為支撐日元所採取的干預行動，也包括美方在阿根廷上次大選前，為穩定披索所做的努力。
曾任總體經濟交易員的貝森特表示：「每當有人說，『財長這是在冒險』，我要說，這正是我夢寐以求的局面。我掌握不對稱資訊，現在莊家是我。」
他接著說：「因此，當我們出手干預日元時，我非常清楚日本政府、日本央行及日本決策官員接下來會怎麼做。你想跟我對賭，儘管來。」
到目前為止，美方的外匯干預已取得成效；相較之下，財政部宣布將買進長天期美債後，殖利率僅短暫回落。貝森特介入債市的做法，也遭到其恩師、知名投資人德魯肯米勒（Stanley Druckenmiller）批評。
美日聯手干預前，美元兌日元一度逼近164，目前已回落至約153，最新跌幅約0.32%。
高盛分析師普里沃羅茨基（Rich Privorotsky）在報告中指出，貝森特這番談話帶來的次級效應，才是影響股市的關鍵。市場擔心，隨著日元升值，原本借入低利率日元、再投入其他資產的投資人，將不得不縮減甚至完全平倉，亦即所謂的日元套利交易可能加速退場。
普里沃羅茨基表示：「當以日元融資的套利交易解除，資金回流日本債券與股票時，市場會發生什麼事？」他指出，標普500指數和大型科技股近期在缺乏明顯基本面利空的情況下，走勢卻異常沉重。值得留意的是，部分槓桿與套利部位可能正逐步從市場消退。
瑞銀全球財富管理首席經濟學家唐納文（Paul Donovan）則表示：「只有當日元貶值是由投機因素造成時，賭場的比喻才成立。如果干預前的日元匯價是由基本面驅動，那麼更貼切、儘管較少人熟悉的比喻，應是英國1992年的匯率機制危機。在這種情況下，貝森特應該宣稱：『我就是拉蒙特。』」
拉蒙特（Norman Lamont）當時擔任英國財政大臣，曾試圖讓英國留在歐洲匯率機制內，但最終未能成功。
paras_en: US Treasury Secretary Biden is known for speaking bluntly, but his remarks on Tuesday night at the Business School of Southern Methodist University may be the toughest stance he’s taken in his political career.
Biden discussed not only the Treasury’s recent intervention to support the yen, but also US efforts to stabilize the peso before Argentina’s last election.

Former macro trader Biden said, "Whenever someone says, 'The Treasury is taking a risk,' I reply that this is exactly the scenario I’ve dreamed of. I have asymmetric information, and now I am the house."
He added, "So when we intervene in the yen, I know exactly what the Japanese government, the Bank of Japan and Japanese policymakers will do next. If you want to bet against me, go ahead."

So far the US foreign‑exchange intervention has shown results; by contrast, after the Treasury announced it would buy long‑term US bonds, yields only fell briefly. Biden’s move into the bond market was also criticized by his mentor, famed investor Stanley Druckenmiller.
Before the US‑Japan joint intervention, the dollar‑yen rate briefly approached 164, now it has slipped to about 153, a recent decline of roughly 0.32%.

Goldman Sachs analyst Rich Privorotsky noted in a report that the secondary effects of Biden’s comments are the real driver for equities. The market worries that a stronger yen will force investors who borrowed cheap yen to fund other assets to unwind or fully close those positions, accelerating the exit of yen‑carry trades.

Privorotsky said, "When yen‑funded arbitrage unwinds and capital flows back into Japanese bonds and stocks, what will happen to the market?" He pointed out that the S&P 500 and large‑cap tech stocks have been unusually heavy despite a lack of clear fundamental downside, and that some leveraged and arbitrage positions may be gradually disappearing from the market.

UBS Global Wealth Management chief economist Paul Donovan said, "The casino analogy only holds if yen depreciation is driven by speculation. If the pre‑intervention yen rate was fundamentally driven, a more apt, though less familiar, comparison is the 1992 UK exchange‑rate mechanism crisis. In that case, Biden should claim: 'I am Lamont.'"
Norman Lamont was the UK Chancellor at the time who tried to keep Britain in the European Exchange Rate Mechanism but ultimately failed.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元小幅波動 市場聚焦央行會議
items.title_en: New York FX Market: Dollar Shows Minor Fluctuations, Market Focuses on Central Bank Meetings
paras: 美元周三(9日)變動不大，市場焦點持續落在近期大幅走強的日元。外匯市場參與者正為關鍵的時刻做準備，歐洲央行(ECB)本周將公布利率決議，聯準會(Fed)與日本銀行(BoJ)將於下周公布決策。
美國公債市場同樣受關注，財政部公布備受期待的公債回購操作更新後，規模令投資人失望。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.1%，報98.83。
美國財政部宣布將回購60億美元、到期年限10年至20年的美國公債，高於先前的20億美元，消息公布後市場拋售美債，美國公債殖利率大幅上升。
美國財政部上月曾表示，將把公債回購規模提高至至少40億美元，但媒體報導此前市場預期規模至少會達到100億美元。
美國10年期公債殖利率上升3.5個基點至4.839%。在財政部公布消息前，殖利率僅上升1.2個基點至4.816%。對利率更加敏感的美國2年期公債殖利率則上升2.7個基點至4.425%。
財政部的回購行動原本被視為一項意外的干預措施，目的是限制美國公債殖利率持續飆升的走勢，而美債近期一直遭遇大規模拋售。
此次美債拋售受到多重因素推動，包括油價飆升引發的通膨疑慮、企業為支應人工智慧基礎建設而大舉發債所帶來的市場擔憂，以及對美國國債規模持續膨脹的疑慮。
布魯金斯研究院經濟研究資深研究員Robin Brooks表示，「試圖透過公債回購等方式，人為壓低長期殖利率的問題在於，如果市場認為回購規模太小，殖利率反而會跳升。這顯示市場底層的上行壓力非常強勁。」
目前市場正密切等待周四公布的8月生產者物價指數(PPI)及周五公布的消費者物價指數(CPI)，以尋找進一步的利率線索。如果通膨數據高於預期，可能使市場對聯準會下周升息的預期明顯升溫。
日元持續徘徊逾七個月高點
日元已成為主要貨幣中表現最亮眼貨幣，光是9月以來就上漲4%。本月初開始的強勁漲勢，周二一度推動日元升至152.89兌1美元的高點。周三日元延續升勢，美元兌日元下跌0.2%，至153.63。
日元受到日本銀行政策收緊預期及市場廣泛猜測日本政府可能再次干預匯市等因素支撐。金融市場幾乎已確定日本銀行將於9月18日升息25個基點，交易員也認為，日本銀行總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)可能暗示年底前還會進一步推動貨幣政策正常化。
LPL Financial技術策略師Adam Turnquist周二表示，「日元的漲勢反映出基本面與技術面真正發生轉變，日銀正進一步走向政策正常化，同時突破原有趨勢。投資人應密切關注152這個關鍵價位，若日元明確突破該支撐並進一步升值，可能加速日元漲勢、迫使更多空頭回補，並重新引發日元套利交易平倉的風險，進而對包括美國公債在內的全球資產產生連鎖影響。」
本周稍早公布的官方數據顯示，日本8月外國證券持有量創紀錄減少878億美元。外匯存底的大幅下降，直接為東京規模達15兆日元(976.7億美元)的匯市干預行動提供資金，其中部分行動是與美國同步進行。
其他貨幣方面，歐元兌美元上漲0.1%，至1.1629美元。
歐洲央行幾乎已被市場一致預期，周四將升息25個基點。
德意志銀行Jim Reid表示，「市場確實可以討論，在供給衝擊之下，歐洲央行是否應該繼續升息……但市場顯然認為，央行的政策反應函數與能源價格高度相關，近期油價與天然氣價格上漲，使市場對最終利率的定價達到3%。」
他補充，「因此，明天升息基本上已經確定，但接下來的情況就會變得更加複雜。如果能源價格維持在目前水準，經濟成長應該會受到影響，但到目前為止，實際影響遠沒有市場原先預期的那麼大，因此歐洲央行面臨的高度不確定性必須受到重視。」

paras_en: The dollar changed little on Wednesday (the 9th), with market attention still on the yen, which has surged sharply in recent weeks. Forex participants are preparing for a pivotal moment as the European Central Bank (ECB) will announce its rate decision this week, and the Federal Reserve (Fed) and Bank of Japan (BoJ) will release their decisions next week.
The U.S. Treasury market is also in focus; after the Treasury released an eagerly awaited update on its bond repurchase operations, the size disappointed investors.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, rose 0.1% to 98.83.

The U.S. Treasury announced a repurchase of $6 billion of Treasury bonds with maturities of 10 to 20 years, higher than the previously announced $2 billion. After the news, the market sold off Treasuries, and Treasury yields jumped sharply.
Last month the Treasury said it would raise the repurchase size to at least $4 billion, but media reports noted that the market had previously expected the size to be at least $10 billion.

The 10‑year Treasury yield rose 3.5 basis points to 4.839%. Before the Treasury’s announcement, the yield had risen only 1.2 basis points to 4.816%. The more rate‑sensitive 2‑year Treasury yield climbed 2.7 basis points to 4.425%.
The repurchase action was originally seen as an unexpected intervention aimed at curbing the continued surge in Treasury yields, as Treasuries have recently faced large‑scale selling.

The recent Treasury sell‑off was driven by multiple factors, including inflation worries sparked by soaring oil prices, market concerns over corporations issuing massive debt to fund AI infrastructure, and doubts about the ever‑expanding size of U.S. government debt.

Robin Brooks, senior economist at the Brookings Institution, said, "The problem with trying to artificially lower long‑term yields through repurchases is that if the market thinks the repurchase size is too small, yields can actually jump. This shows that the underlying upward pressure in the market is very strong."

The market is now closely awaiting Thursday’s August Producer Price Index (PPI) and Friday’s Consumer Price Index (CPI) for further rate clues. If inflation data comes in hotter than expected, expectations for a Fed rate hike next week could rise sharply.
The yen continues to hover near a seven‑month high.

The yen has become the best‑performing major currency, up 4% since September. A strong rally that began early this month pushed the yen to a high of 152.89 per dollar on Tuesday. On Wednesday the yen kept climbing, with USD/JPY down 0.2% to 153.63.

The yen is being supported by expectations of tighter Bank of Japan policy and widespread speculation that the Japanese government may intervene in the FX market again. The financial markets are almost certain that the BoJ will raise rates by 25 basis points on September 18, and traders also think BoJ Governor Kazuo Ueda may hint at further policy normalization before year‑end.

Adam Turnquist, technology strategist at LPL Financial, said on Tuesday, "The yen’s rally reflects a real shift in fundamentals and technicals, with the BoJ moving further toward policy normalization and breaking its previous trend. Investors should watch the key level of 152 closely; if the yen decisively breaks that support and appreciates further, it could accelerate the rally, force more short covering, and reignite the risk of yen‑carry‑trade unwind, which could have cascading effects on global assets, including U.S. Treasuries."

Official data released earlier this week showed that Japan’s August foreign‑securities holdings fell by a record $87.8 billion. The sharp drop in foreign‑exchange reserves directly funds Tokyo’s ¥15 trillion (about $97.67 billion) FX‑intervention capacity, some of which is coordinated with the United States.
Among other currencies, the euro rose 0.1% against the dollar to $1.1629.
The ECB is almost unanimously expected by the market to raise rates by 25 basis points on Thursday.

Jim Reid of Deutsche Bank said, "The market can indeed discuss whether, under a supply shock, the ECB should keep raising rates… but the market clearly sees the ECB’s policy response function as highly linked to energy prices. Recent spikes in oil and gas have pushed market pricing of the final rate to about 3%."

He added, "Therefore, a rate hike tomorrow is basically a given, but what follows will become more complex. If energy prices stay at current levels, economic growth should be affected, but so far the real impact has been far less than markets originally expected, so the high uncertainty facing the ECB must be taken seriously."

items.title: 日元強勢反攻！日本升息恐掀套利交易平倉 美股、AI科技股小心了
items.title_en: Yen’s Strong Rebound! Japan Rate Hike Could Trigger Arbitrage Unwinding, Watch US Stocks and AI Tech Shares
paras: 日元近期大幅升值，兌美元價位從160一路升破153，然而策略師警告，若日元繼續走強並造成「套利交易」快速平倉，可能引發股市拋售，而高估值的美國科技股將首當其衝。
多年來，華爾街交易員熱愛能「輕鬆賺錢」的「日元套利交易」：以近乎零利率的成本在日本借錢，再把資金投入其他市場追逐更高報酬，主要流向美股市場。
但這項押注如今面臨瓦解風險，近期日元兌美元大幅升值，加上市場普遍預期日本銀行(BOJ, 央行)下周升息，可能重創這項廣受歡迎的交易策略。
日元周二(8日)延續兌美元升勢，盤中一度升破153，最高報152.89日元兌1美元，創2月以來最強。
市場預期日銀下周將大幅升息，成為推動日元上漲的主要動力。市場也開始揣測，日本當局可能再次低調干預外匯市場，以抑制日元近期跌勢。
日元兌美元上周已跌破160整數關卡。160通常被視為關鍵門檻，日元一旦升至這一水準，日本政府干預匯市的可能性將提高。根據FactSet數據，日元兌美元9月迄今已升值近4%。
在此背景下，市場動能可能讓股市投資人暴露在一項意料之外的衝擊中：日元持續升值，進而引發套利交易快速平倉。
所謂套利交易，是指投資人以較低利率借入資金，再投入可能帶來較高報酬的資產。日元套利交易則是借入低收益的日元，買進收益率較高的美元，再將美元投入美國資產，例如科技股。
舉例來說，1年期日本政府公債殖利率約1.55%，1年期美國國庫券殖利率約4.12%，兩者相差約2.57個百分點。換句話說，日元套利交易可藉由這項利差提高投資報酬。
但這項交易也可能以同樣強大的力量反向運作。如果日元突然進一步升值，就像近幾天的走勢一樣，投資人可能被迫迅速解除套利部位。這意味著投資人可能必須賣出以美元計價的資產，再將資金換回日元，以償還以日元計價的借款。
市場不久前就曾承受這種痛楚。2024年夏季日元大幅升值，引發股市震盪，套利交易平倉尤其威脅當時漲勢凌厲的美國科技股。
如今外匯市場可能再次具備類似條件。市場預期日銀將升息，而單是升息預期本身就可能進一步推升日元。
Swissquote資深分析師Ipek Ozkardeskaya表示，這類套利交易平倉「可能對AI／科技股族群造成尤其嚴重的衝擊」，因為高估值與部位過度集中，可能放大潛在的拋售壓力。
她指出，這將為逢低買進創造機會，因為套利交易平倉不會永遠持續，但短期內——可能持續數周，投資人將感受到壓力。
不過，Clocktower Group首席市場策略師Eric Wallerstein認為，這一次日元套利交易出現系統性平倉的可能性不高，因為交易員大多已經預期日元今年還會進一步升值。因此，日元若再突然升值，較不容易讓交易員措手不及，這或許足以避免出現恐慌性的大規模平倉。
Wallerstein表示，只要日本利率仍遠低於全球其他地區，「套利交易就仍會存在」。但若要重演幾年前出現的劇烈震盪，日元必須出現「幅度大且出乎意料」的升值。
2024年夏季套利交易平倉期間，日元兌美元在短短兩個月內升值13%。相比之下，這一次自7月底美元兌日元匯率觸及高點以來，美元兌日元匯率貶值不到6%。
paras_en: The yen has surged sharply lately, climbing from around 160 per dollar to break below 153, but strategists warn that if the yen keeps strengthening and forces a rapid unwind of “arbitrage trades,” it could spark a stock‑market sell‑off, with over‑valued US tech stocks hit first.

For years Wall Street traders have loved the easy‑money “yen arbitrage” play: borrow at near‑zero rates in Japan and deploy the funds into other markets for higher returns, mainly flowing into US equities.

That bet now faces collapse risk as the yen has appreciated sharply against the dollar and markets broadly expect the Bank of Japan to raise rates next week, which could cripple this popular strategy.
The yen continued its rise against the dollar on Tuesday the 8th, briefly breaking the 153 level and peaking at ¥152.89 per $1, its strongest since February.

Markets anticipate a sizable BOJ rate hike next week, the main driver behind the yen’s climb, and are also speculating that Japanese authorities may quietly intervene in FX to curb the yen’s recent rally.

Last week the yen fell below the round‑number barrier of 160 per dollar. The 160 level is seen as a key threshold; once the yen reaches it, the likelihood of government FX intervention rises. FactSet data shows the yen has appreciated about 4% against the dollar so far in September.
Against this backdrop, market momentum could expose equity investors to an unexpected shock: a continuously strengthening yen that triggers a rapid unwind of arbitrage positions.

Arbitrage trades involve borrowing at low rates and investing in higher‑yielding assets. Yen arbitrage means borrowing cheap yen, buying higher‑yielding dollars, and deploying those dollars into US assets such as tech stocks.

For example, the 1‑year Japanese government bond yields about 1.55% while the 1‑year US Treasury yields about 4.12%, a spread of roughly 2.57 percentage points, allowing yen arbitrage to boost investment returns.

But the same mechanism can work in reverse. If the yen suddenly appreciates further, as it has in recent days, investors may be forced to unwind arbitrage positions quickly, selling dollar‑denominated assets and converting the proceeds back to yen to repay yen‑denominated loans.
The market felt this pain not long ago. In the summer of 2024 a sharp yen rally rattled equities, and the unwinding of arbitrage trades especially threatened the then‑soaring US tech sector.
Now the FX market may again present similar conditions. Expectations of a BOJ rate hike alone could further lift the yen.
Swissquote senior analyst Ipek Ozkardeskaya said such arbitrage unwinds “could hit AI/tech stocks especially hard” because high valuations and concentrated positions can amplify sell‑pressure.
She added that this could create buying opportunities on dips, since arbitrage unwinds won’t last forever, but in the short term—potentially for several weeks—investors will feel the strain.

However, Clocktower Group chief market strategist Eric Wallerstein believes the chance of a systemic unwind this time is low, as traders largely anticipate further yen gains this year, making a sudden move less likely to catch them off guard and possibly averting panic‑driven mass unwinds.

Wallerstein noted that as long as Japanese rates remain far below those elsewhere, “arbitrage trades will persist.” Yet to repeat the severe volatility seen a few years ago, the yen would need to appreciate “dramatically and unexpectedly.”

During the summer 2024 unwind, the yen rose 13% against the dollar in just two months. By contrast, since the end of July when the USD/JPY peaked, the dollar has depreciated less than 6% against the yen.

items.title: 全球2.34兆美元日元套利交易要變天？日銀升息恐再掀平倉潮
items.title_en: Will the $2.34 trillion Global Yen Arbitrage Trade Turn the Tide? BOJ Rate Hikes Could Spark Another Wave of Unwinding
paras: 日元近期升至7個月高點，市場開始關注，長年支撐全球金融市場的「日元套利交易」是否正走向終點。隨著投資人預期日銀(日本央行/BOJ)最快可能在下周會議加速升息，借入低利日元、轉投資高收益資產的策略正面臨考驗。
所謂套利交易，是借入日元等低利率貨幣，再兌換成美元、墨西哥披索、紐西蘭元或其他新興市場貨幣，投資當地債券或金融工具。交易結束後，投資人再將收益換回日元並償還貸款，賺取兩國利差；若期間日元貶值，還能獲得額外匯兌收益。

美日利差縮小 日元套利吸引力逐漸下降

日元多年來一直是最受歡迎的融資貨幣。美元兌日元套利交易的年率報酬通常約2.5%至3.5%，主要來自美日利差，已低於2024年時的5%至6%。在東京與華盛頓7月底聯手買進日元、干預匯市後，部分套利投資人似乎開始轉向瑞士法郎融資。
現代日元套利交易約在2013年成形。時任日本首相安倍晉三推動量化與質化寬鬆政策，適逢美國利率上升及日元貶值，吸引國際投資人借入日元。2022年至2023年，聯準會(Fed)為抑制通膨快速升息，日銀卻維持負利率，加上日元重貶，套利交易規模進一步膨脹。
由於許多交易透過衍生性商品、避險基金及高槓桿操作，市場無法掌握確切規模。不過，Jefferies分析國際清算銀行(BIS)資料發現，截至今年3月，跨境日元借款已攀升至創紀錄的360兆日元，約2.34兆美元，為近30年最大一波套利交易累積。
美國商品期貨交易委員會(CFTC)數據則顯示，截至9月1日當周，日元淨空單增至92,227口，連續第3周上升，但仍低於7月1日當周創下的兩年高點163,412口。考量基金普遍使用槓桿，實際曝險可能遠高於期貨數據呈現的規模。

2024年曾掀全球股災 這次市場已有準備

若日元突然大幅升值，投資人便須買回日元償還借款，並拋售原先持有的股票、債券與高收益貨幣，可能形成連鎖賣壓。2024年7月，日銀意外升息至當時15年高點，日元數日內從約154日元兌1美元急升至141日元，迫使套利交易迅速平倉，全球股市隨之重挫，日經225指數更曾單日暴跌12.4%。
不過，目前尚無跡象顯示類似衝擊正在重演。日銀官員近幾周已持續暗示升息將至，未來可能還需要進一步收緊政策，市場因此有時間調整部位。日元這波升值走勢也相對有序，股市至今大致消化升息訊號。
這意味日元套利交易可能逐步退潮，而非像2024年般突然瓦解。然而，面對規模龐大且高度槓桿化的部位，只要日銀升息幅度超出預期或日元漲勢突然加速，全球市場仍可能再度承受平倉衝擊。
paras_en: The yen has recently risen to a seven‑month high, prompting markets to wonder whether the long‑standing "yen arbitrage trade" that underpins global finance is nearing its end. With investors expecting the Bank of Japan (BOJ) could accelerate rate hikes as early as next week’s meeting, the strategy of borrowing cheap yen to chase higher‑yielding assets is coming under pressure.

Arbitrage trades involve borrowing yen or other low‑interest currencies, converting them into dollars, Mexican pesos, New Zealand dollars or other emerging‑market currencies, and investing in local bonds or financial instruments. After the trade is closed, investors convert the returns back into yen to repay the loan, pocketing the interest‑rate differential; if the yen depreciates during the holding period, they also capture extra foreign‑exchange gains.

The yen’s appeal as a financing currency is waning as the US‑JPY spread narrows. For years the yen has been the most popular funding currency. Annual returns on USD/JPY arbitrage typically range from about 2.5% to 3.5%, driven mainly by the US‑Japan rate gap, down from 5%‑6% in 2024. After Tokyo and Washington jointly bought yen and intervened in the currency market at the end of July, some arbitrageurs appear to be shifting toward Swiss‑franc financing.

Modern yen arbitrage took shape around 2013. Then‑Prime Minister Shinzo Abe pushed quantitative and qualitative easing while US rates were rising and the yen was weakening, attracting international investors to borrow yen. From 2022 to 2023 the Fed hiked aggressively to curb inflation while the BOJ kept rates negative and the yen kept falling, causing the arbitrage market to swell further.

Because many trades are executed through derivatives, hedge funds and high‑leverage structures, the exact size of the market is hard to gauge. However, Jefferies’ analysis of BIS data shows that by March this year cross‑border yen borrowing had surged to a record 360 trillion yen – about $2.34 trillion – the largest accumulation of arbitrage activity in the past 30 years.

CFTC data indicate that for the week ending September 1, net short positions on yen futures rose to 92,227 contracts, marking a third consecutive week of increase, though still below the two‑year peak of 163,412 contracts set in the week of July 1. Given that funds typically use leverage, the actual exposure may be far higher than the futures numbers suggest.

If the yen were to appreciate sharply, investors would have to buy yen to repay loans and sell the stocks, bonds and high‑yield currencies they hold, potentially triggering a cascade of selling pressure. In July 2024 the BOJ unexpectedly raised rates to a 15‑year high, sending the yen from roughly ¥154 per dollar to ¥141 within days, forcing a rapid unwind of arbitrage positions and sending global equities tumbling, with the Nikkei 225 plunging 12.4% in a single day.

So far there are no signs that a similar shock is replaying. BOJ officials have been hinting in recent weeks that further rate hikes are imminent and that policy may need to tighten further, giving markets time to adjust positions. The yen’s recent appreciation has been relatively orderly, and equity markets have largely digested the rate‑hike signal.

This suggests that yen arbitrage may recede gradually rather than collapse abruptly as in 2024. Nevertheless, given the massive and highly leveraged exposure, any BOJ rate‑hike larger than expected or a sudden acceleration in yen gains could still deliver another round of forced liquidations to global markets.

items.title: 34年前「金融偷獵者」 大獲全勝 貝森特改換角色當莊家
items.title_en: 34 Years Ago the ‘Financial Predator’ Won Big, Bessent Switches Role to Become the House
paras: 美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)本周展現出極具戰術性的貨幣政策風格，公開向外匯交易員喊話，大膽宣告「我現在就是莊家」。他強調自己對日本央行與日本政策制定者的行動擁有「資訊不對稱」優勢，並直接挑戰市場交易員敢不敢與他作對。
這種將主導權掌握在手的強硬作風，深深植根於他34年前協助索羅斯「擊潰英格蘭銀行」的頂尖避險基金經歷。
據《Fortune》記者Eva Roytburg報導，1992年時年僅29歲的貝森特洞察到英格蘭銀行的致命弱點：央行承諾將英鎊維持在歐洲匯率機制(ERM)的狹幅區間內，但透過升息來保衛匯率的做法，會嚴重打擊當時持有浮動利率房貸的英國屋主。
貝森特成功說服老闆索羅斯對英鎊發動大規模做空，最終迫使英國退出ERM，並為基金賺進10億美元利潤。Roytburg總結，貝森特從中汲取的關鍵教訓是：「當央行人為將貨幣維持在市場無法支持的水準時，市場最終將會獲勝」。
34年後，貝森特角色互換，從昔日的「金融偷獵者」變成了坐鎮局面的「金融護林員」。據報導，貝森特目前正與日本當局協調購買日元，且他多次暗示希望東京當局調升利率，而非僅依賴反覆干預。在他的警告與干預下，美元兌日元匯率已從2026年7月的163上方，一路回落至9月8日的153.96。
然而，這套強硬手法也在內部引發質疑；昔日索羅斯時期的同僚Stanley Druckenmiller公開指責他介入債券市場是個錯誤，而貝森特則反駁稱，擴大買回舊美債旨在冷卻美國公債市場的「發燒」現象。
據《路透》報導，日本央行預計在即將召開的會議上提高基準利率，這成為驗證貝森特威懾是否有效的即時測試。若日本當局順利升息，貝森特的豪賭就能成立；若日本猶豫不決，這位曾寫下狙擊央行教科書的掌權者，將親自驗證市場規律是否會反噬自己。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent this week displayed a highly tactical monetary‑policy style, publicly telling foreign‑exchange traders, “I am the house now.” He stressed that he has an information‑asymmetry advantage over the Bank of Japan and Japanese policymakers and directly challenged market participants to see if they dare to go against him.
This hard‑line approach of keeping control in his own hands is deeply rooted in his experience 34 years ago when he helped George Soros’s top hedge fund “crush the Bank of England.”

According to Fortune reporter Eva Roytburg, in 1992 the then‑29‑year‑old Bessent spotted a fatal weakness in the Bank of England: the central bank’s commitment to keep the pound within the narrow band of the European Exchange Rate Mechanism (ERM, then called the “snake”) would, if defended by raising rates, severely hurt British homeowners with variable‑rate mortgages.

Bessent successfully persuaded his boss Soros to launch a massive short on the pound, ultimately forcing the UK out of the ERM and earning the fund a $1 billion profit. Roytburg summed up Bessent’s key lesson: “When a central bank artificially holds a currency at a level the market cannot support, the market will eventually win.”

Thirty‑four years later Bessent has swapped roles, turning from a “financial predator” into a “financial forest‑ranger” who sits at the table. Reports say he is now coordinating with Japanese authorities to buy yen and has repeatedly hinted that he wants Tokyo to raise rates rather than rely solely on repeated interventions. Under his warnings and actions the USD/JPY rate has fallen from above 163 in July 2026 to 153.96 on September 8.

However, this hard‑line play has sparked internal criticism; Stanley Druckenmiller, a former colleague from the Soros era, publicly said Bessent’s foray into the bond market was a mistake, while Bessent retorted that expanding purchases of old U.S. Treasuries is meant to cool the “fever” in the U.S. government‑bond market.

Reuters reports that the Bank of Japan is expected to raise its policy rate at the upcoming meeting, providing an immediate test of whether Bessent’s deterrence works. If Japanese authorities hike rates, Bessent’s big gamble pays off; if they hesitate, the man who once wrote the textbook on targeting central banks will see market forces turn against him.

items.title: G10貨幣黑馬恐失色！主要央行升息潮壓頂 英鎊漲勢面臨回檔危機
items.title_en: G10 Currency Dark Horse May Lose Its Luster! Central Bank Rate‑Hike Wave Peaks, Pound’s Rise Faces Pull‑Back Risk
paras: 儘管英國政府再次更迭、地緣政治帶來衝擊，英鎊大致上未受影響，今年來表現優於許多主要貨幣，然而，近期這股動能逐漸減弱，而且疲弱走勢恐怕將進一步加劇。
今年以來，英鎊兌歐元升值約1.6%，兌瑞士法郎升值2.8%，兌瑞典克朗升值4.9%，兌加拿大元升值1%。同期間，英鎊兌美元大致持平，兌日元則貶值1.3%。
英國前首相施凱爾(Keir Starmer)7月20日辭職後，英國迎接10年內第七位上台的領導人，市場密切關注新政府是否會遵守前財政大臣Rachel Reeves強調的「財政規則」。
在同樣來自中間偏左工黨的資深政治人物柏南(Andy Burnham)上台後，英國長期借貸成本走高，但這與全球政府公債遭拋售的走勢同步。

英國長期借貸成本創1998年以來最高

金融服務公司Ebury市場策略主管Matthew Ryan表示，過去三個月以來，英鎊是G10富裕國家貨幣中「意外強勢的貨幣」，主要歸因於英國經濟韌性超乎預期。
英國第2季國內生產毛額(GDP)成長0.4%，第1季則成長0.6%，在已開發經濟體中表現數一數二強勁。晴朗天氣以及FIFA世界盃帶來的熱潮提振消費支出，而儘管地緣政治局勢動盪，企業活動仍展現超乎預期的韌性。
Rabobank資深外匯策略師Jane Foley表示，4月伊朗衝突爆發初期，，由於市場預期英國央行(BOE)將為因應通膨疑慮而升息，成為當時支撐英鎊的力量。
英國易受油價及天然氣價格上漲的影響，而這兩種天然資源今年均大幅上漲，導致整體通膨率升抵近3%水準。

英鎊弱勢可能加劇？

儘管物價壓力再度升溫，英國央行迄今仍將基準利率維持在3.75%。
目前市場定價顯示，英國9月17日會議升息的機率偏低。相較之下，市場高度預期歐洲央行(ECB)本周將升息，對聯準會(Fed)本月17日升息的預期也日益升高。
Rabobank的Foley指出，在柏南政府10月28日將公布首份年度預算案，市場正為此感到不安之際，英國央行下周若釋出鴿派訊息，將「進一步讓英鎊暴露在風險之中」。
英國新任財政大臣John Healey周一在演講中表示，他仍將致力於維持財政紀律，同時希望讓經濟成長更平均分布於英國各地，而非集中在經濟核心倫敦。
摩根大通英國經濟學家Allan Monks表示，他的談話顯示，在借貸成本上揚的背景下，政府對稅收及支出政策的調整將採取審慎態度。預算案可能繼續聚焦於地方分權、提高公共服務的政府控制，以及與民間部門建立更多合作關係，但對整體經濟展望的改變有限。
Ebury的Ryan表示，這份預算案具有高度政治風險，可能包含「提高附加稅率以及增加發債」，以支應柏南政府的支出計畫。
他表示，相關措施可能包括調整房產購買稅及地方政府稅、引進「豪宅稅」，以及收緊退休金與個人投資帳戶的稅務優惠。他補充，若市場認為相關措施可能抑制經濟成長並壓縮民間部門，同時又需要增加借款，市場將對此感到不安。
paras_en: Despite a reshuffled UK government and geopolitical shocks, the pound has largely been unaffected and has outperformed many major currencies this year, but its momentum has recently been waning and a weak trend could worsen further.

Since the start of the year the pound has appreciated about 1.6% against the euro, 2.8% against the Swiss franc, 4.9% against the Swedish krona and 1% against the Canadian dollar. Over the same period it has been roughly flat versus the US dollar and down 1.3% versus the Japanese yen.

After former Prime Minister Keir Starmer resigned on July 20, the UK welcomed its seventh leader in ten years, and markets are watching closely whether the new administration will adhere to the “fiscal rules” emphasized by former finance minister Rachel Reeves.
Following the ascent of senior Labour figure Andy Burnham, long‑term borrowing costs in the UK have risen, a trend that mirrors the global sell‑off of sovereign bonds.

Long‑term borrowing costs in the UK have hit their highest level since 1998. Matthew Ryan, head of market strategy at financial‑services firm Ebury, said the pound has been the “surprisingly strong currency” among G10 affluent‑nation currencies over the past three months, mainly because the UK economy’s resilience has exceeded expectations.

UK GDP grew 0.4% in Q2 after a 0.6% gain in Q1, making it one of the strongest performers among developed economies. Sunny weather and the FIFA World Cup hype boosted consumer spending, and despite geopolitical turbulence, business activity showed unexpectedly robust resilience.

Rabobank senior FX strategist Jane Foley noted that when the Iran conflict erupted in early April, markets expected the Bank of England to raise rates to combat inflation, which at the time supported the pound.
The UK is vulnerable to rising oil and natural‑gas prices, both of which have surged sharply this year, pushing overall inflation close to the 3% level.
Could a weaker pound exacerbate the situation? Although price pressures have heated up again, the Bank of England has kept its policy rate at 3.75% so far.

Current market pricing shows a low probability of a rate hike at the BoE meeting on September 17. By contrast, markets heavily anticipate an ECB hike this week and are increasingly pricing in a Fed hike on the 17th of this month.

Foley of Rabobank warned that with Burnham’s government set to unveil its first annual budget on October 28 and markets already uneasy, a dovish signal from the BoE next week would “further expose the pound to risk”.

New finance minister John Healey told a speech on Monday that he will continue to uphold fiscal discipline while aiming to spread economic growth more evenly across the UK rather than concentrating it in the core economy of London.

Morgan Stanley economist Allan Monks said his comments indicate that, against a backdrop of rising borrowing costs, the government will take a cautious approach to tax and spending policy adjustments. The budget is likely to keep focusing on devolution, tighter public‑service oversight and more public‑private partnerships, with limited impact on the overall economic outlook.
Ryan of Ebury said the budget carries high political risk and may include “higher surcharge rates and increased borrowing” to fund Burnham’s spending plans.

He added that measures could involve changes to property purchase tax and local‑government tax, the introduction of a “luxury‑home tax”, and tighter tax breaks for pensions and individual investment accounts, and warned that if markets think such steps could curb growth, squeeze the private sector and require more borrowing, anxiety would rise.

items.title: 日元急升散戶逆勢加碼看空 淨空頭部位達3.61兆日元
items.title_en: Yen Soars Rapidly as Retail Traders Double Down on Short Bets, Net Short Position Hits ¥3.61 trillion
paras: 日元兌美元匯率近期急劇反彈至數月來高點，但日本散戶並未改變對日元的看空立場，反而維持傳統「逆勢操作」習慣，持續加碼日元淨空頭倉位。
根據日本金融期貨協會及東京金融交易所資料，上周日本散戶持有的日元淨空頭部位，估計達約 3.61 兆日元(約 235 億美元)，高於 8 月水準；此前 7 月的日元空頭部位更一度衝上 4.41 兆日元，創下自 2015 年以來最高紀錄。
本月以來，日元兌美元已升值約 4%，一度突破 153 關卡並觸及 152 日元水位。推動這波升勢的主因包括市場預期日本央行將進一步升息，以及外界揣測日本政府退休金投資基金(GPIF)等機構，可能調整資產配置，帶動日元強勁需求並觸發大規模停損賣單。
這與海外投資者的行為形成鮮明對比——外資急於解除日元套利交易，部分避險基金甚至押注美元兌日元在年底前將跌破 150 關卡。
瑞穗銀行高級策略師中島將行警告，若日元持續走強，散戶最終恐被迫平倉美元多頭，停損引發的美元拋售可能進一步推升日元。
SBI Liquidity Market 常務董事鈴木亮補充，美元跌破 155 後散戶追買美元的傾向已略微放緩，且散戶自發停損意願有所提高，但若匯率持續單邊升值，部分高槓桿部位仍面臨強制平倉的風險。
paras_en: The yen‑dollar exchange rate has surged sharply to a multi‑month high, yet Japanese retail investors have not altered their bearish stance on the yen; instead, they continue their traditional contrarian habit by adding to their net short yen positions.

According to data from the Japan Financial Futures Association and the Tokyo Financial Exchange, last week Japanese retail investors held net short yen positions estimated at about ¥3.61 trillion (roughly $23.5 billion), higher than the August level; earlier, the July short position had briefly spiked to ¥4.41 trillion, the highest since 2015.

Since the start of the month the yen has appreciated about 4% against the dollar, briefly breaking the 153‑yen barrier and touching the 152‑yen level. The rally is driven mainly by market expectations that the Bank of Japan will raise rates further and speculation that institutional investors such as the Government Pension Investment Fund may rebalance assets, sparking strong yen demand and triggering large stop‑loss sell orders.

This contrasts sharply with overseas investors’ behavior—foreign capital is rushing to unwind yen‑carry trades, and some hedge funds are even betting that the dollar‑yen pair will fall below the 150 level before year‑end.

Mizuho Bank senior strategist Nakashima warned that if the yen keeps strengthening, retail traders may eventually be forced to close their long‑dollar positions, and the resulting dollar sell‑off could push the yen even higher.

SBI Liquidity Market executive director Suzuki Ryo added that after the dollar slipped below 155, retail appetite for buying dollars has eased slightly and their willingness to stop‑loss has risen, but if the exchange rate continues its one‑sided appreciation, some highly leveraged positions still face the risk of forced liquidation.

items.title: 美元走勢疲軟逼近7個月低點 美債回購與通膨數據成焦點
items.title_en: Dollar Weakness Near 7-Month Low as Treasury Buybacks and Inflation Data Take Center Stage
paras: 隨著日元強勁反彈以及市場緊盯美國財政部即將公布的公債回購計畫與通膨數據，美元指數已逼近近7個月來的最低點。
彭博美元指數周三(9日)一度下跌0.2%，創下自2月18日以來的最低。其中，日元作為指數的第二大組成貨幣，當天上升0.5%，將本月的累計漲幅擴大至約4%。
美元走勢承壓，部分源於美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)的強硬表態。貝森特公開向交易員發起挑戰，要求市場試探他壓低美債殖利率與強化日元的決心，並準備透過擴大公債回購計畫來抑制殖利率。美財政部預計於周三稍晚宣布買回10年期至20年期在外流通公債的具體規模。
傑富瑞(Jefferies)歐洲首席經濟學家兼策略師Mohit Kumar表示，買回規模需超過40億美元才能對市場產生實質影響，首波操作規模不排除達到80億至100億美元；不過摩根大通研究人員則認為財政部可能不會透露更多細節。
另一方面，市場正密切關注周五公布的美國通膨數據，此數據將塑造聯準會(Fed)下周的政策決策方向，目前貨幣市場預估升息一碼(0.25個百分點)的機率約為60%。
整體而言，期權指標顯示交易員短期內對美元維持看空態度。然而，受美伊交火影響，布蘭特原油已上漲至每桶100美元，高企的能源價格對歐元與英鎊構成壓力，使美元對這兩大貨幣仍有進一步走高的空間。
paras_en: As the yen rebounds strongly and markets focus on the U.S. Treasury’s upcoming bond buyback plan and inflation data, the dollar index has edged close to its lowest level in nearly seven months.

The Bloomberg dollar index fell 0.2% on Wednesday the 9th, hitting its lowest point since February 18. The yen, the index’s second‑largest component, rose 0.5% that day, expanding its month‑to‑date gain to about 4%.

The dollar’s pressure stems in part from Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent’s hard‑line stance. Bessent publicly challenged traders to test his resolve to push down Treasury yields and strengthen the yen, and said the Treasury is ready to expand its bond‑buyback program to curb yields. The Treasury plans to announce later Wednesday the specific size of the buyback of outstanding 10‑ to 20‑year bonds.

Jefferies Europe chief economist and strategist Mohit Kumar said the buyback would need to exceed $4 billion to have a material market impact, with the first tranche possibly reaching $8‑10 billion; however, JPMorgan researchers think the Treasury may not disclose further details.

Meanwhile, markets are closely watching U.S. inflation data due on Friday, which will shape the Fed’s policy direction next week. Money‑market participants currently estimate about a 60% probability of a 0.25‑percentage‑point rate hike.

Overall, options indicators show traders remain short on the dollar in the short term. Yet, amid the Israel‑Iran clash, Brent crude has risen to $100 a barrel, and the high energy prices are pressuring the euro and pound, leaving room for the dollar to climb further against those two major currencies.
